title: Capital gain netting — Omar Haddad
instructions: Omar Haddad, single, had the capital transactions below in 2025. Compute each amount. Enter losses as positive numbers.

exhibits.title: 2025 transactions
exhibits.content:
1. Sold Ardent Co. stock held 3 years: basis $20,000; proceeds $35,000.
2. Sold Bexley Inc. stock held 5 months: basis $18,000; proceeds $12,000.
3. Sold investment land held 2 years: basis $26,000; proceeds $30,000.
4. Sold stock his mother gave him in June 2025, two months before the sale. Her basis was $5,000 (held 6 years); fair value at the gift was $8,000; proceeds $11,000. No gift tax was paid.
5. Long-term capital loss carryforward from 2024: **$9,000**.

rows.label: Gain on the gifted stock
rows.explanation: Gain basis is the donor's 5,000: 11,000 − 5,000 = **6,000**. The donor's holding period tacks, so it is long-term.

rows.label: Net long-term capital gain (after the carryforward)

parts.prompt: Holding period of the gifted stock

rows.label: Holding period of the gifted stock
options: Long-term — the donor's holding period carries over
Short-term — Omar held it only two months
rows.answer: Long-term — the donor's holding period carries over
rows.explanation: When the donee uses the donor's basis, the donor's holding period is added (§1223(2)).
